title: Sable and the Protocol
author: Beatrix Oyelaran
blurb: Casper Villalobos, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
